messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int main()
{string s;
int mark=0;
cin>>s;
for (int i=0;i<s.size();i++)
{if (i==0)
cout<<s[i];
else
if(s[i]=='d'&&s[i+1]=='o'&&s[i+2]=='t'&&i+2!=s.size()-1)
{
cout<<'.';
i+=2;
}
else
if (mark==0&&s[i]=='a'&&s[i+1]=='t'&&i+1!=s.size()-1)
{

cout<<'@';
mark++;
i++;
}
else
cout<<s[i];
}
return 0;
}
